channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Are Iran, US really close to a breakthrough ‘deal’?
item.description: Trump says a deal with Iran could be signed in Europe over the weekend. Tehran cautions against speculation.

item.title: One injured as Israel hits southern Lebanon with air raids, artillery
item.description: The attacks come as Iranian media reports that a draft peace deal with the US would include ending the war in Lebanon.

item.title: A year after Air India crash killed 260: Do we know what happened?
item.description: Families of victims still await a final report about the Boeing 787 Dreamliner that crashed in Ahmedabad last year.

item.title: Nigeria killed more than 13,000 ‘terrorists’ in past year, president says
item.description: President Tinubu takes victorious tone despite recent mass kidnappings by armed groups across the country.

item.title: Family mourn Indian sailor killed in US strike on oil tanker
item.description: The wife and family of an Indian sailor killed in a US strike on a tanker off Oman this week have gathered in mourning.

item.title: Video: What Iran’s football fans think about the World Cup
item.description: What’s it like supporting your team in a World Cup hosted by a country that’s at war with yours?

item.title: Tehran says 'nothing' finalised after Trump claims deal to end Iran war near
item.description: Iran says reports of a deal are "speculative" after the US president says a "great settlement" to end the conflict has been reached.

item.title: 'They destroyed the future': Palestinian anger at rise in Israeli demolitions in East Jerusalem
item.description: Palestinian homes are being pulled down in occupied East Jerusalem to make way for a park.

item.title: Four days of extreme rain killed 7% of world's rarest orangutans, study says
item.description: Climate change-induced weather events are pushing orangutan populations to extinction, says a study.

item.title: Vance says Israeli PM Netanyahu 'has got some things wrong'
item.description: The US vice-president says the Israeli leader "aggressively asserts" his country's interests, but they do not always align with those of the US.
